name: Flash black
summary: Quick dip to black and back up with adjustable attack and decay; a punchy cut for drops and scene breaks.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: decay
params.note: frames to lift back to the scene
